items.headline: Atacicept keeps kidney function stable for two years in a common kidney disease
items.summary: In final phase three results published in the New England Journal of Medicine, atacicept cut kidney-function decline events from 38 to 11 over two years in people with IgA nephropathy.
items.why_it_matters: IgA nephropathy is a leading cause of kidney failure in young adults, and few treatments slow it.

items.headline: Malaria vaccine price cut by about 40 percent, freeing funds for up to a million more children
items.summary: Gavi and UNICEF secured a lower price for the RTS,S malaria vaccine, saving about 50 million dollars over 2027 to 2029.
items.why_it_matters: Malaria kills hundreds of thousands of African children every year, and cheaper doses stretch limited vaccine budgets.
